title: QOF (QualityOfLife)
description: This mod adds a new qof recipes
body:
Tired of having to explore to have a chance of finding something u really want? well wait no more because now you can craft them!

Added Recipes:

Name Tag

Sticy Piston (you can use Honey Comb instead of Slimeball)

Trident

Bottle O' Enchanting

Budding Amethyst

And all the Horse Armors.
